give_coverage_evidence.source: Rennert et al. (2022), Nature, DOI 10.1038/s41586-022-05224-9, archived GIVE reproduction package
verified_logic: CIAM defines RelocateNoAdapt, RelocateRetreat, and OptimalRelocate
RelocateNoAdapt includes costs for people, mobile capital, and demolition after coastal dry-land loss
OptimalCost selects protection, retreat, or no-adaptation subcosts and includes OptimalRelocate where applicable
MimiGIVE computes marginal sea-level damages from CIAM OptimalCost
